install.note: For native Windows use npm, Scoop, Chocolatey, or a binary from the official GitHub Releases. https://opencode.ai/install.ps1 returned 404 during the 2026-09-08 audit and is not listed in the official Windows install docs. Upstream recommends WSL for its full Linux environment; EchoBird detects native Windows installs separately. Bun installation on Windows is not yet supported in the docs. npm gets platform binaries from optional dependencies in the npm registry; keep those dependencies enabled. The Unix installer downloads from GitHub Releases. Verify with `opencode --version` after refreshing PATH.

install_flow.summary: macOS/Linux: official shell installer or package manager; native Windows: npm / Scoop / Chocolatey / release binary → verify
agent_steps: macOS / Linux: prefer `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash` (downloads the prebuilt binary to ~/.opencode/bin, no Node needed). On network failure, fall back to `brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode` then npm.

Windows: use `npm i -g opencode-ai` with an installed Node/npm, or `scoop install opencode` / `choco install opencode` when that manager is already available. Otherwise use the official release binary. Do not pipe https://opencode.ai/install into iex: it is a Bash script. The former install.ps1 endpoint is unavailable.

npm path (all platforms): check Node/npm and the current package engine requirement, then run `npm i -g opencode-ai` with optional dependencies enabled. If a registry download fails, diagnose it and, with the user's mirror fallback selected, use `npm i -g opencode-ai --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com --fetch-timeout=600000`.
Verify with `opencode --version`. On Windows if the command isn't found after an npm install, the shim is at %APPDATA%\npm\opencode.cmd — restart the shell so PATH picks it up.

If an earlier npm install timed out, DO NOT immediately retry: a still-running node/postinstall may be writing to the same node_modules and a concurrent retry corrupts it. Let the runner kill the process tree first (handled automatically on timeout), or manually confirm no node/npm process is running before retrying.
tell_user: Which install method was used (curl / scoop / choco / release binary / npm)
On Windows the npm global shim is %APPDATA%\npm\opencode.cmd — restart the shell if `opencode` isn't found

blocked_regions.zh-CN: The Bash installer downloads from GitHub Releases. If those hosts are unreachable, npm obtains the platform binary through optional dependencies from the selected registry. Use the user's configured proxy or approved registry mirror; verify the download instead of assuming regional access.

first_run.description: On first launch `opencode` opens a TUI. To use your own provider, add an OpenAI-compatible provider block in the config file, or run /login and pick a provider. OpenRouter, Anthropic, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint are supported.

identity_guard.description: OpenCode is Anomaly/Charm's open-source CLI coding agent (github.com/anomalyco/opencode), npm package `opencode-ai`. It is DIFFERENT from: Claude Code (Anthropic, @anthropic-ai/claude-code), Codex CLI (OpenAI, @openai/codex), and the OpenCode *Desktop* GUI app — a separate EchoBird tool. When installing via npm, use the exact package name `opencode-ai`; do not confuse it with the others.
